skill.name: Project Architecture
skill.description: Architecture reference for a Next.js 15 and Docusaurus project using TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Better Auth, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle.
skill.summary: Explains the project stack, folder roles, and hybrid app architecture.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown inline code for package names, directory paths, and documented npm scripts. I found no executable code, prompt injection text, data exfiltration intent, or semantic security issue in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - `/app`: Next.js App Router pages and layouts.
- **Auth Integration**: Shared authentication state between Next.js and Docusaurus via cookies/sessi
- **Styling**: Global Tailwind styles in `app/globals.css`. Docusaurus has its own theme in `textboo
- **Hybrid App**: Combines a Next.js web app (marketing, auth, dashboard) with a Docusaurus document

content.value_statement: Project contributors need quick context before making changes. This skill summarizes the documented stack, directories, and architecture patterns for guided AI assistance.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes the documented Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Docusaurus, Better Auth, PostgreSQL, and Drizzle stack.
Identifies the main project directories and their documented roles.
Explains the hybrid Next.js and Docusaurus application pattern.
Describes shared authentication state through cookies and sessions.
Lists the documented development commands for root, docs, and combined apps.
limitations: Covers only the architecture details present in SKILL.md.
Does not inspect repository files or verify that the structure is current.
Does not provide deployment, security, or database migration procedures.
Mentions development commands but does not execute them.

use_cases.title: Onboard a Developer
use_cases.description: Get a concise map of the stack, folder layout, and application boundaries before starting a task.

use_cases.title: Plan Documentation Changes
use_cases.description: Understand how the Docusaurus documentation area relates to the main Next.js application.

use_cases.title: Prepare AI Coding Context
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code architecture context before asking for implementation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to summarize the project architecture. Include the stack, main directories, and key patterns in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Right Area
prompt_templates.prompt: Based on this architecture skill, tell me which project area is most relevant for an authentication UI change.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Documentation Impact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this architecture overview to explain which directories may be affected by a Docusaurus documentation update.

prompt_templates.title: Review Cross-App Assumptions
prompt_templates.prompt: Before proposing a shared authentication change, identify architecture assumptions, affected boundaries, and repository details to verify.

output_examples.input: Explain how this project is organized.
output_examples.output: The project combines a Next.js web application with a Docusaurus documentation site. Application pages live in app, shared UI lives in components, and documentation lives in textbook.

output_examples.input: Where should I look for authentication context?
output_examples.output: Start with the documented auth files in lib and the auth-related components under components. Verify the current files before editing.

output_examples.input: What should I verify before changing docs authentication?
output_examples.output: Check how cookies and sessions are shared between the Next.js app and Docusaurus. Confirm the current implementation before proposing changes.

best_practices: Use this skill as starting context, then verify details against the current repository.
Ask for directory-level impact before large implementation changes.
Pair the overview with task-specific file reads before editing code.
anti_patterns: Do not assume every listed path exists without checking current files.
Do not treat documented development commands as proof that scripts are safe.
Do not make deployment or security decisions from this overview alone.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It provides architecture context for a project that combines Next.js, Docusaurus, authentication, and database layers.

faq.question: Does it change project files?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a documentation reference and does not modify files.

faq.question: Can it run the listed npm commands?
faq.answer: No. It only documents the commands that a user may choose to run separately.

faq.question: Is the architecture guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. Users should verify the current repository before relying on the overview for edits.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is this a security review tool?
faq.answer: No. It describes architecture and does not perform security analysis.
